$$
\begin{aligned}\int_C f\,\text{d}s=\int_a^b f(r(t))\,\|r'(t)\|\,\text{d}t.\end{aligned}
$$

Since $r(t)=(t^{2})\,i+(t)\,j$, then along the curve we have $x=t^{2}$, $y=t$.

Computing $r'(t)$ and $\|r'(t)\|,$ we get the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}r'(t) & =\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t}\,i+\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}t}\,j \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(t^{2})\,i+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(t)\,j \\  & =(2 t)\,i+(1)\,j \\ \|r'(t)\| & =\sqrt{(\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t})^2+(\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}t})^2} \\  & =\sqrt{(2 t)^2+(1)^2} \\  & =\sqrt{4 t^{2} + 1}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, since $f(x,y)=4 y$, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}f(r(t)) & =(4)(t) \\  & =4 t\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we can write the integral as

$$
\begin{aligned}\int_C f\,\text{d}s & ={\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{6}}f(r(t))\,\|r'(t)\|\,\text{d}t \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{6}}(4 t)(\sqrt{4 t^{2} + 1})\,\text{d}t\end{aligned}
$$

We can solve this using the substitution $u=4 t^{2} + 1$, $\text{d}u=(8 t)\,\text{d}t$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{6}}4 t \sqrt{4 t^{2} + 1}\,\text{d}t & ={\int }_{1}^{25}\frac{1}{2}\cdot u^{1/2}\,\text{d}u \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{2}{3}u^{3/2}\big|_{1}^{25} \\  & =\frac{1}{3}[(25)^{3/2}-(1)^{3/2}] \\  & =\frac{1}{3}[(125)-(1)] \\  & =(\frac{125}{3})-(\frac{1}{3}) \\  & =\frac{124}{3}\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["ad468d44-fb68-5a19-a5ba-ce398186f0b5"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "1987e49f-7e77-5919-82aa-6b139e1177b0" :answer/id #uuid "1987e49f-7e77-5919-82aa-6b139e1177b0" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{231}{2}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "eeca22e3-cbf7-5b3d-b018-b1647008ca68" :answer/id #uuid "eeca22e3-cbf7-5b3d-b018-b1647008ca68" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{2728}{3}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "2833fcec-8de1-5841-b608-35c960c0bcd3" :answer/id #uuid "2833fcec-8de1-5841-b608-35c960c0bcd3" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "33" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "0494b507-6893-5677-8d04-d371af5154b5" :answer/id #uuid "0494b507-6893-5677-8d04-d371af5154b5" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "11" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "2285e068-d56d-5138-acec-6227d8e0efff" :answer/id #uuid "2285e068-d56d-5138-acec-6227d8e0efff" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{341}{3}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "852e0dd8-5a52-5753-be99-a707534ca752" :answer-field/id #uuid "852e0dd8-5a52-5753-be99-a707534ca752" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["1987e49f-7e77-5919-82aa-6b139e1177b0" "eeca22e3-cbf7-5b3d-b018-b1647008ca68" "2833fcec-8de1-5841-b608-35c960c0bcd3" "0494b507-6893-5677-8d04-d371af5154b5" "2285e068-d56d-5138-acec-6227d8e0efff"] :answer-field/correct "2285e068-d56d-5138-acec-6227d8e0efff" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "3c132797-532b-531b-ac79-d0e890e2f4b0" :question/id #uuid "3c132797-532b-531b-ac79-d0e890e2f4b0" :question/problem "Evaluate the line integral of the function $f(x,y)=11 y$ along the curve parametrized by $r(t)=\langle t^{2},t\rangle$ for $t\in [0,\sqrt{6}].$" :question/worked-solution "To calculate the line integral, we will use the formula

"Evaluate the line integral of the function $f(x,y,z)=\frac{2 y + 2 z}{x}$ along the curve parametrized by $r(t)=\langle 2 t,t^{2},\frac{3 t^{2}}{2}\rangle$ for $t\in [\sqrt{2},\sqrt{3}].$" :question/worked-solution "To calculate the line integral, we will use the formula

$$
\begin{aligned}\int_C f\,\text{d}s=\int_a^b f(r(t))\,\|r'(t)\|\,\text{d}t.\end{aligned}
$$

Since $r(t)=(2 t)\,i+(t^{2})\,j+(\frac{3 t^{2}}{2})\,k$, then along the curve we have $x=2 t$, $y=t^{2}$, $z=\frac{3 t^{2}}{2}$.

Computing $r'(t)$ and $\|r'(t)\|,$ we get the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}r'(t) & =\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t}\,i+\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}t}\,j+\frac{\text{d}z}{\text{d}t}\,k \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(2 t)\,i+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(t^{2})\,j+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(\frac{3 t^{2}}{2})\,k \\  & =(2)\,i+(2 t)\,j+(3 t)\,k \\ \|r'(t)\| & =\sqrt{(\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t})^2+(\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}t})^2+(\frac{\text{d}z}{\text{d}t})^2} \\  & =\sqrt{(2)^2+(2 t)^2+(3 t)^2} \\  & =\sqrt{13 t^{2} + 4}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, since $f(x,y,z)=\frac{2 y + 2 z}{x}$, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}f(r(t)) & =\frac{(2)[(t^{2})+(\frac{3 t^{2}}{2})]}{2 t} \\  & =\frac{(5)t^2}{(2)t} \\  & =\frac{5 t}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we can write the integral as

$$
\begin{aligned}\int_C f\,\text{d}s & ={\int }_{\sqrt{2}}^{\sqrt{3}}f(r(t))\,\|r'(t)\|\,\text{d}t \\  & ={\int }_{\sqrt{2}}^{\sqrt{3}}(\frac{5 t}{2})(\sqrt{13 t^{2} + 4})\,\text{d}t\end{aligned}
$$

We can solve this using the substitution $u=13 t^{2} + 4$, $\text{d}u=(26 t)\,\text{d}t$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{\sqrt{2}}^{\sqrt{3}}\frac{5 t \sqrt{13 t^{2} + 4}}{2}\,\text{d}t & ={\int }_{30}^{43}\sqrt{u}\cdot \frac{5}{52}\,\text{d}u \\  & =\frac{5}{52}{\int }_{30}^{43}u^{1/2}\,\text{d}u \\  & =\frac{5}{52}\cdot\frac{2}{3}u^{3/2}\big|_{30}^{43} \\  & =\frac{5}{78}[(43)^{3/2}-(30)^{3/2}] \\  & =\frac{5}{78}[(43 \sqrt{43})-(30 \sqrt{30})] \\  & =(\frac{215 \sqrt{43}}{78})-(\frac{25 \sqrt{30}}{13}) \\  & =- \frac{25 \sqrt{30}}{13} + \frac{215 \sqrt{43}}{78}\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard :question/answer-fields ["e67895d3-d4ec-5187-b82d-db3c871037c4"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "generator" :question-generator/id #uuid "623e9a21-ee3c-5252-a5fd-20564b20242c" :question-generator/script "generate/scratch/17592186133827.py"} [:db/add 17592186133827 :knowledge-point/question-generator "generator"] {:db/id 17592186133827 :knowledge-point/questions ["c45dcc44-5b16-5bcb-8c40-42484661e768" "3c132797-532b-531b-ac79-d0e890e2f4b0" "3aeb7177-27b3-5c11-a4d0-3497fd32abae" "353d7359-1a70-56e3-a4d7-6e5a53fc624b" "bc131f90-387e-54b0-bfab-a8eb22f2797f" "c2ce718e-45c4-5f03-8361-b5c8663f79aa" "4598c153-f2b3-5aa3-bf7d-421ba3e4749e" "4eee203b-5512-5c93-95fe-15ef6820bb5a" "660f6c2f-13cf-5ed3-95da-d564af1963e0" "610b886f-b7bb-5ac0-b2cd-087760dc82c1"]} [:db/ensure 17592186133827 :knowledge-point/validate]]
